purpose: Source-authored contracts for Inferno law profiles that require gated, sacrifice, or teleported identity semantics. This is static traceability only and does not authorize gameplay mutation.
validationState: source-prepared-static-only; runtime proof is still required before gameplayAllowed can become true.

forbiddenSubstitutes: ordinary permanent casualty counted as gated or sacrifice identity
generic kill or loss event counted as gated or sacrifice identity
gatedOrSummoned unit tag counted as transaction proof
summoned unit existence without loss or sacrifice transaction proof
Inferno faction membership counted as gated or sacrifice identity
fire damage or fire spell counted as sacrifice identity
RequiresGatedOrSacrificeIdentity.notes: Frenzy requires exact gated temporary-loss or sacrifice transaction identity. Existing kill/loss evidence is companion evidence only; gameplay still requires transaction identity, owner correlation, permanent casualty exclusion, and idempotence proof.

forbiddenSubstitutes: ordinary movement counted as gated or teleported identity
generic adjacency counted as gated or teleported identity
gatedOrSummoned unit tag counted as movement identity proof
Inferno faction membership counted as gated or teleported identity
teleport-themed spell text counted without movement event proof
geometry predicate counted as gated or teleported identity
RequiresGatedOrTeleportedIdentity.notes: Hellpack Assault requires exact gated-entry or teleport movement identity before adjacency behavior can apply. Geometry is companion evidence only; gameplay still requires movement event identity, acting stack identity, owner correlation, and post-movement adjacency ordering proof.

requiredRuntimeProof: gated entry or teleport movement event proof
acting or lost stack identity proof
idempotent per-transaction or per-movement application proof
